title: Shesha-khanda, part 4 (portion 49)
html:
The section "The Lord Sees Vrindavana" (continued): Krishnadasa shows the Lord the places of Krishna's pastimes — the stealing of the clothes, Govardhana, the places of the nauka-lila and the dana-lila, the ponds; the ashoka grove blossoms at the Lord's glance; at the place of the rasa the Lord is in ecstasy, and Krishnadasa tells the rasa-lila (with passages found only in the 1983 edition)

Raga shri; disha: "Ah, my wondrous Gora! People say: a youth of pure gold"

গোপকুমারিকা ব্রত কৈল এইখানে ।
কাম্য কৈল—দাসী হব কৃষ্ণের চরণে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

gopakumārikā brata kaila eikhāne |
kāmya kaila—dāsī haba kṛṣṇera caraṇe || 206 ||

gopa-kumarika — the cowherd maidens; vrata kaila — kept a vow; eikhane — here; kamya kaila — desired; dasi haba — we shall be maidservants; krishnera charane — at Krishna's feet

206Here the cowherd maidens kept a vow;
they desired: "Let us become maidservants at Krishna's feet"1.

বস্ত্র আভরণ তারা থুঞা এই ঘাটে ।
জলে নামি' স্নান তারা করয়ে লাঙটে ॥ ২০৭ ॥

bastra ābharaṇa tārā thuñā ei ghāṭe |
jale nāmi' snāna tārā karaẏe lāṅaṭe || 207 ||

vastra abharana — clothes and ornaments; tara thunya — they, leaving; ei ghate — at this ghata; jale nami — entering the water; snana tara karaye — they bathe; langte — naked

207Leaving their clothes and ornaments on this ghata,
they entered the water and bathe naked.

আচম্বিতে বস্ত্র-আভরণ লইয়া হরি ।
নীপতরু-পরে উঠি' হাসে ধীরে ধীরে ॥ ২০৮ ॥

ācambite bastra-ābharaṇa laiẏā hari |
nīpataru-pare uṭhi' hāse dhīre dhīre || 208 ||

achambite — suddenly; vastra-abharana laiya — taking the clothes and ornaments; hari — Hari; nipa-taru-pare uthi — climbing onto a nipa (kadamba) tree; hase dhire dhire — laughs softly

208Suddenly Hari, taking the clothes and ornaments,
climbed a kadamba tree and laughs softly.

গোপকুমারিকা স্তুতি অনেক যতনে ।
তুষ্ট হঞা দিল তারে বস্ত্র-আভরণে ॥ ২০৯ ॥

gopakumārikā stuti aneka yatane |
tuṣṭa hañā dila tāre bastra-ābharaṇe || 209 ||

gopa-kumarika — the cowherd maidens; stuti aneka yatane — [offer] praise with great effort; tushta hanya — being pleased; dila tare — He gave them; vastra-abharane — the clothes and ornaments

209The maidens praise Him with great effort;
pleased, He gave them back their clothes and ornaments.

বৃন্দাবনে প্রশংসয়ে শিশু সম্বোধিয়া ।
যজ্ঞপত্নী-স্থানে অন্ন খাইল মাগিয়া ॥ ২১০ ॥

bṛndābane praśaṃsaẏe śiśu sambodhiẏā |
yajñapatnī-sthāne anna khāila māgiẏā || 210 ||

vrindavane prashamsaye — He praises Vrindavana; shishu sambodhiya — addressing the boys; yajna-patni-sthane — from the wives of the sacrificers; anna khaila magiya — He asked for food and ate

210[Here] He praised Vrindavana, addressing the boys;
[here] He asked food of the wives of the sacrificing brahmanas and ate.

কংসের উৎপাতে সব গোপ ভয় পাঞা ।
নন্দীশ্বর-গিরিতে আশ্রয় কৈল গিয়া ॥ ২১১ ॥

kaṃsera utpāte saba gopa bhaẏa pāñā |
nandīśbara-girite āśraẏa kaila giẏā || 211 ||

kamsera utpate — through Kamsa's outrages; saba gopa bhaya panya — all the cowherds, being afraid; nandishvara-girite — on the hill Nandishvara; ashraya kaila giya — went and took shelter

211Through Kamsa's outrages all the cowherds, in fear,
went and took shelter on the hill Nandishvara.

বসতি করিল মানসগঙ্গার দু-কূলে ।
বিলাস করিল গোবর্ধনের শিখরে ॥ ২১২ ॥

basati karila mānasagaṅgāra du-kūle |
bilāsa karila gobardhanera śikhare || 212 ||

vasati karila — they settled; manasa-gangara du-kule — on both banks of the Manasa-Ganga; vilasa karila — He sported; govardhanera shikhare — on the summit of Govardhana

212They settled on both banks of the Manasa-Ganga,
and He sported on the summit of Govardhana.

ইন্দ্র-সনে বাদ করি' এ পর্বত ধরে ।
তুলিলেক মহাগিরি সপ্তম-বৎসরে ॥ ২১৩ ॥

indra-sane bāda kari' e parbata dhare |
tulileka mahāgiri saptama-batsare || 213 ||

indra-sane vada kari — contending with Indra; e parvata dhare — He holds this mountain; tulileka mahagiri — He lifted the great hill; saptama-vatsare — in His seventh year

213Contending with Indra, He holds up this mountain:
the great hill He lifted in His seventh year.

মানসগঙ্গার ধারা পর্বত-ঈশানে ।
স্থল নাহি, পার হৈতে নারে গোপীগণে ॥ ২১৪ ॥

mānasagaṅgāra dhārā parbata-īśāne |
sthala nāhi, pāra haite nāre gopīgaṇe || 214 ||

manasa-gangara dhara — the stream of the Manasa-Ganga; parvata-ishane — north-east of the hill; sthala nahi — there is no dry land; para haite nare gopigane — the gopis cannot cross

214The stream of the Manasa-Ganga lies north-east of the hill;
there is no dry land, and the gopis cannot cross.

নৌকা পারাবার করি' বাড়ায় কৌতুক ।
জলে ভাসি' দেহ গোপী দিলেক যৌতুক ॥ ২১৫ ॥

naukā pārābāra kari' bāṛāẏa kautuka |
jale bhāsi' deha gopī dileka yautuka || 215 ||

nauka paravara kari — ferrying by boat; badaya kautuka — He increases the fun; jale bhasi — floating on the water; deha gopi dileka yautuka — the gopis gave [their] bodies as a gift

215Ferrying them in a boat, He increases the fun,
and in the midst of the water the gopis gave themselves to Him as a gift2.

পর্বতের মধ্য দিয়া আছে রাজপথ ।
গোকুল-মথুরার লোক করে গতাগত ॥ ২১৬ ॥

parbatera madhya diẏā āche rājapatha |
gokula-mathurāra loka kare gatāgata || 216 ||

parvatera madhya diya — through the hill; achhe rajapatha — there is a highroad; gokula-mathurara loka — the people of Gokula and Mathura; kare gatagata — come and go

216Through the hill runs a highroad:
the people of Gokula and Mathura come and go on it.

পর্বত-উপরে হের দেখ রম্য স্থান ।
এইখানে গোপিকার সাধে মহাদান ॥ ২১৭ ॥

parbata-upare hera dekha ramya sthāna |
eikhāne gopikāra sādhe mahādāna || 217 ||

parvata-upare — on the hill; hera dekha — here, see; ramya sthana — a lovely place; eikhane — here; gopikara sadhe mahadana — He exacts the great toll from the gopis

217Here, see, on the hill is a lovely place:
here He exacts the great toll from the gopis.

বসিয়া সাধিত দান এই ত পাষাণে ।
এই দানচৌতারা প্রভু দেখ বিদ্যমানে ॥ ২১৮ ॥

basiẏā sādhita dāna ei ta pāṣāṇe |
ei dānacautārā prabhu dekha bidyamāne || 218 ||

basiya sadhita dana — sitting, He exacted the toll; ei ta pashane — on this very rock; ei dana-chautara — this is the toll platform; prabhu dekha vidyamane — Lord, see it before You

218Sitting on this very rock He exacted the toll;
this is the toll-collector's platform, Lord — see it before You"3.

পাষাণ দেখিয়া প্রভু গদগদ-স্বর ।
অরুণ-বরণ ভেল সব কলেবর ॥ ২১৯ ॥

pāṣāṇa dekhiẏā prabhu gadagada-sbara |
aruṇa-baraṇa bhela saba kalebara || 219 ||

pashana dekhiya — seeing the rock; prabhu gadgada-svara — the Lord's voice falters; aruna-varana bhela — became crimson; saba kalevara — His whole body

219Seeing the rock, the Lord spoke in a faltering voice,
and His whole body turned crimson.

নিজ কর দিয়া প্রভু মাজয়ে পাষাণ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে প্রভু বসিবার স্থান ॥ ২২০ ॥

nija kara diẏā prabhu mājaẏe pāṣāṇa |
ekadṛṣṭe cāhe prabhu basibāra sthāna || 220 ||

nija kara diya — with His own hand; prabhu majaye pashana — the Lord rubs the rock; ekadrishte chahe — gazes fixedly; prabhu basibara sthana — the Lord at the place of sitting

220With His own hand the Lord strokes the rock
and gazes fixedly at the place where [Krishna] sat.

ক্ষণে বুক দেয় ক্ষণে করে নমস্কার ।
ক্ষণে বোলে—রাধা, দান দেহ না আমার ॥ ২২১ ॥

kṣaṇe buka deẏa kṣaṇe kare namaskāra |
kṣaṇe bole—rādhā, dāna deha nā āmāra || 221 ||

kshane buka deya — now He presses His chest [to it]; kshane kare namaskara — now He bows; kshane bole — now He says; radha — Radha; dana deha na amara — will you not pay Me My toll

221Now He presses His chest to it, now He bows,
now He says: "Radha, why do you not pay Me My toll?"4

অবশ শরীর প্রভু পড়ে ভূমিতলে ।
ক্ষণেতে উঠিয়া সে পাথর করে কোলে ॥ ২২২ ॥

abaśa śarīra prabhu paṛe bhūmitale |
kṣaṇete uṭhiẏā se pāthara kare kole || 222 ||

avasha sharira — His body powerless; prabhu pade bhumitale — the Lord falls to the ground; kshanete uthiya — rising at once; se pathara kare kole — He embraces that stone

222His body powerless, the Lord falls to the ground,
then suddenly rises and embraces that stone.

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—গোসাঞি, শুন মোর বোল ।
দেখিবে ত সব স্থান, নহ উতরোল ॥ ২২৩ ॥

kṛṣṇadāsa bole—gosāñi, śuna mora bola |
dekhibe ta saba sthāna, naha utarola || 223 ||

krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; gosani shuna mora bola — Gosani, hear my word; dekhibe ta saba sthana — You will surely see all the places; naha utarola — do not be agitated

223Krishnadasa says: "Gosani, listen to me:
You will surely see all the places — do not be agitated.

পর্বতের পূর্বে দেখ এ কুসুমবন ।
তাহার দক্ষিণে রাসমণ্ডলের স্থান ॥ ২২৪ ॥

parbatera pūrbe dekha e kusumabana |
tāhāra dakṣiṇe rāsamaṇḍalera sthāna || 224 ||

parvatera purve — east of the hill; dekha e kusuma-vana — see this Kusuma-vana (flower grove); tahara dakshine — to its south; rasa-mandalera sthana — the place of the rasa circle

224See, east of the hill is this Kusuma-vana [the flower grove];
to its south is the place of the rasa circle."

এ বোল বলিতে গোরা বোলে—রহ রহ ।
শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল-কথা ভালমতে কহ ॥ ২২৫ ॥

e bola balite gorā bole—raha raha |
śrīrāsamaṇḍala-kathā bhālamate kaha || 225 ||

e bola balite — as he said this; gora bole — Gora says; raha raha — stop, stop; sri-rasa-mandala-katha — the account of the holy rasa circle; bhalamate kaha — tell it properly

225As soon as he said this, Gora says: "Stop, stop!
Tell properly about the holy rasa circle."

রাধাকৃষ্ণ রাস কৈল—সেই এই স্থান ।
এ বোল বলিতে গোরার ঝরে দু-নয়ান ॥ ২২৬ ॥

rādhākṛṣṇa rāsa kaila—sei ei sthāna |
e bola balite gorāra jhare du-naẏāna || 226 ||

radha-krishna rasa kaila — Radha and Krishna danced the rasa; sei ei sthana — this is that place; e bola balite — as this was said; gorara jhare du-nayana — Gora's two eyes stream

226"Radha and Krishna danced the rasa — this is that very place."
As soon as he said this, tears streamed from Gora's eyes.

হাহা কৃষ্ণ, হাহা রাধা—বোলে বারবার ।
অরুণ-নয়ানে ঝরে সাত-পাঁচ ধার ॥ ২২৭ ॥

hāhā kṛṣṇa, hāhā rādhā—bole bārabāra |
aruṇa-naẏāne jhare sāta-pāṁca dhāra || 227 ||

haha krishna haha radha — "O Krishna! O Radha!"; bole barabara — He says again and again; aruna-nayane — from His reddened eyes; jhare sata-pancha dhara — countless streams flow

227"O Krishna! O Radha!" He says again and again;
from His reddened eyes flow countless streams.

শ্রীরাসমণ্ডল বলি' পাড়ে গড়াগড়ি ।
ক্ষণে উভ বাহু তুলি' হুঙ্কার ছাড়ি ॥ ২২৮ ॥

śrīrāsamaṇḍala bali' pāṛe gaṛāgaṛi |
kṣaṇe ubha bāhu tuli' huṅkāra chāṛi || 228 ||

sri-rasa-mandala bali — saying "the holy rasa circle"; pade gadagadi — He rolls on the ground; kshane ubha bahu tuli — now raising both arms; hunkara chhadi — letting out loud roars

228Crying "The holy rasa circle!" He rolls on the ground,
now, raising both arms, He lets out loud roars.

জানুর উপরে জানু ত্রিভঙ্গিম রহে ।
শুন শুন বলি' রাধাকৃষ্ণ-কথা কহে ॥ ২২৯ ॥

jānura upare jānu tribhaṅgima rahe |
śuna śuna bali' rādhākṛṣṇa-kathā kahe || 229 ||

janura upare janu — knee over knee; tribhangima rahe — He stands thrice-bent; shuna shuna bali — saying "listen, listen"; radha-krishna-katha kahe — He tells of Radha and Krishna

229Placing knee over knee He stands thrice-bent5,
and, saying "listen, listen," He tells of Radha and Krishna.

পুনঃ কি কহিব বলি' অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ।
এইখানে হয়ে রাধাকৃষ্ণ কৈল রাস ॥ ২৩০ ॥

punaḥ ki kahiba bali' aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa |
eikhāne haẏe rādhākṛṣṇa kaila rāsa || 230 ||

punah ki kahiba bali — saying "what more shall I say?"; atta-atta hasa — loud laughter; eikhane haye — right here; radha-krishna kaila rasa — Radha and Krishna danced the rasa

230And again: "What more shall I say?" — and He laughs aloud:
"Right here Radha and Krishna danced the rasa!"

বিহ্বল দেখিয়া গৌর, বোলে কৃষ্ণদাস—
পর্বত-উপরে রাধা-কদম্ব-বিলাস ॥ ২৩১ ॥

bihbala dekhiẏā gaura, bole kṛṣṇadāsa—
parbata-upare rādhā-kadamba-bilāsa || 231 ||

vihvala dekhiya gaura — seeing Gaura overwhelmed; bole krishnadasa — Krishnadasa says; parvata-upare — on the hill; radha-kadamba-vilasa — the pastime-place of the Radha-kadamba

231Seeing Gaura overwhelmed, Krishnadasa says:
"On the hill is the place of pastimes by the Radha-kadamba6.

দেখ ইন্দ্র-আরাধন—অন্নকূট-স্থান ।
ইন্দ্রপূজা বাধ কৃষ্ণ কৈল এই স্থান ॥ ২৩২ ॥

dekha indra-ārādhana—annakūṭa-sthāna |
indrapūjā bādha kṛṣṇa kaila ei sthāna || 232 ||

dekha — see; indra-aradhana — the worship of Indra; annakuta-sthana — the place of the Annakuta; indra-puja badha — the stopping of Indra's worship; krishna kaila ei sthana — Krishna did at this place

232See — the place of the Annakuta, where [the cowherds] worshipped Indra:
at this place Krishna stopped the worship of Indra.

অভিমানে আপনা পাশরে ইন্দ্ররাজ ।
ঝড় বরিষণ কৈল গোয়ালা-সমাজ ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

abhimāne āpanā pāśare indrarāja |
jhaṛa bariṣaṇa kaila goẏālā-samāja || 233 ||

abhimane — in pride; apana pashare — forgets himself; indraraja — King Indra; jhada varishana kaila — sent storm and rain; goyala-samaja — on the cowherd community

233In his pride King Indra forgot himself
and sent storm and rain upon the cowherd community.

সেইরূপ মূর্তি দেখ পর্বত-শিখরে ।
হরিরায় নাম মূর্তি পর্বত-উপরে ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

seirūpa mūrti dekha parbata-śikhare |
harirāẏa nāma mūrti parbata-upare || 234 ||

seirupa murti — a Deity of that form; dekha parvata-shikhare — see on the hilltop; hariraya nama murti — the Deity named Hariraya; parvata-upare — on the hill

234See — on the hilltop is a Deity in that very form:
the Deity named Hariraya on the hill.

গোবর্ধন-উপরে দক্ষিণভাগে বাস ।
গোপালরায় নাম, হেথা কৃষ্ণের বিলাস ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

gobardhana-upare dakṣiṇabhāge bāsa |
gopālarāẏa nāma, hethā kṛṣṇera bilāsa || 235 ||

govardhana-upare — on Govardhana; dakshina-bhage vasa — dwells on the southern side; gopalaraya nama — named Gopalaraya; hetha krishnera vilasa — here are Krishna's pastimes

235On Govardhana, on the southern side, dwells
[the Deity] named Gopalaraya: here are Krishna's pastimes.

ইন্দ্রদর্প হরি' চড়ে পর্বত-শিখরে ।
এথা ইন্দ্র-অভিষেক রাজরাজেশ্বরে ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

indradarpa hari' caṛe parbata-śikhare |
ethā indra-abhiṣeka rājarājeśbare || 236 ||

indra-darpa hari — taking away Indra's pride; chade parvata-shikhare — He climbs the hilltop; etha — here; indra-abhisheka rajarajeshvare — Indra's anointing of the King of kings

236Having crushed Indra's pride, He climbs to the hilltop:
here Indra performed the anointing of the King of kings7.

সর্বপাপহর কুণ্ড পর্বত-দক্ষিণে ।
তাহার উপরে দেখ শিলা উবটনে ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

sarbapāpahara kuṇḍa parbata-dakṣiṇe |
tāhāra upare dekha śilā ubaṭane || 237 ||

sarva-papa-hara kunda — the pond that removes all sins; parvata-dakshine — south of the hill; tahara upare — above it; dekha shila ubatane — see the stone of anointing

237South of the hill is the pond that removes all sins;
above it, see, is the stone of anointing8.

আর পাঁচ কুণ্ড দেখ পর্বত-উপর ।
ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড, রুদ্রকুণ্ড—সর্বতীর্থসার ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

āra pāṁca kuṇḍa dekha parbata-upara |
brahmakuṇḍa, rudrakuṇḍa—sarbatīrthasāra || 238 ||

ara pancha kunda — five more ponds; dekha parvata-upara — see on the hill; brahma-kunda rudra-kunda — the Brahma-kunda, the Rudra-kunda; sarva-tirtha-sara — the essence of all tirthas

238See — on the hill are five more ponds:
the Brahma-kunda and the Rudra-kunda — the essence of all tirthas,

ইন্দ্রকুণ্ড, সূর্যকুণ্ড, মোক্ষকুণ্ড-নামে ।
পৃথিবীতে যত তীর্থ ইহাতে বিশ্রামে ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

indrakuṇḍa, sūryakuṇḍa, mokṣakuṇḍa-nāme |
pṛthibīte yata tīrtha ihāte biśrāme || 239 ||

indra-kunda surya-kunda — the Indra-kunda, the Surya-kunda; moksha-kunda-name — named Moksha-kunda; prithivite yata tirtha — all the tirthas on earth; ihate vishrame — rest in them

239[and] the ponds named Indra-kunda, Surya-kunda and Moksha-kunda:
all the tirthas on earth rest in them.

এইখানে দ্বাদশী-পারণা-স্নানকালে ।
বরুণে হরিল নন্দ—কৃষ্ণ দেখিবারে ॥ ২৪০ ॥

eikhāne dbādaśī-pāraṇā-snānakāle |
baruṇe harila nanda—kṛṣṇa dekhibāre || 240 ||

eikhane — here; dvadashi-parana-snana-kale — at the bath before breaking the fast on Dvadashi; varune harila nanda — Varuna carried off Nanda; krishna dekhibare — in order to see Krishna

240Here, when [Nanda] bathed before breaking the fast on Dvadashi,
Varuna carried Nanda off in order to see Krishna.

ব্রহ্মকুণ্ড-মজ্জন এই দেখ বৃন্দাবন ।
কৃষ্ণের বিভব শিশু দেখহ নয়ন ॥ ২৪১ ॥

brahmakuṇḍa-majjana ei dekha bṛndābana |
kṛṣṇera bibhaba śiśu dekhaha naẏana || 241 ||

brahma-kunda-majjana — the immersion in the Brahma-kunda; ei dekha vrindavana — here, see, Vrindavana; krishnera vibhava — Krishna's glory; shishu dekhaha nayana — the children [of Vraja] see with their eyes

241Here is the Brahma-kunda where [the cowherds] were immersed — see, here is Vrindavana: [here] the children [of Vraja] saw Krishna's glory with their own eyes9.

অশোক-বন দেখ এই কুণ্ডের উত্তরে ।
এক আশ্চর্য কথা শুনহ ইহারে ॥ ২৪২ ॥

aśoka-bana dekha ei kuṇḍera uttare |
eka āścarya kathā śunaha ihāre || 242 ||

ashoka-vana dekha — see the ashoka grove; ei kundera uttare — north of this pond; eka ashcharya katha — a wonderful account; shunaha ihare — hear about it

242See — north of this pond is an ashoka grove;
hear a wonderful account about it.

কার্তিক-পূর্ণিমা-তিথি দিবসের মাঝে ।
কুসুমিত হয় তরু, দেখে সর্বরাজ্যে ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

kārtika-pūrṇimā-tithi dibasera mājhe |
kusumita haẏa taru, dekhe sarbarājye || 243 ||

kartika-purnima-tithi — on the full-moon day of Kartika; divasera majhe — in the middle of the day; kusumita haya taru — the trees burst into flower; dekhe sarva-rajye — the whole land sees

243On the full-moon day of Kartika, in the middle of the day,
the trees [here] burst into flower, and the whole land sees it."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু নেহারয়ে বন ।
অকালে পুষ্পিত তরু ভৈগেল তখন ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu nehāraẏe bana |
akāle puṣpita taru bhaigela takhana || 244 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu neharaye vana — the Lord gazes at the grove; akale pushpita taru — the trees blossomed out of season; bhaigela takhana — became then

244Hearing this, the Lord gazes at the grove —
and at once the trees blossomed out of season.

মুঞ্জরিত তরু লতা, ফল-ফুল কোলে ।
অদ্ভুত দেখিয়া কৃষ্ণদাস কিছু বোলে ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

muñjarita taru latā, phala-phula kole |
adbhuta dekhiẏā kṛṣṇadāsa kichu bole || 245 ||

munjarita taru lata — trees and creepers in blossom; phala-phula kole — holding fruits and flowers; adbhuta dekhiya — seeing the wonder; krishnadasa kichhu bole — Krishnadasa speaks

245Trees and creepers came into blossom, laden with fruit and flowers;
seeing this wonder, Krishnadasa speaks.

অদ্ভুত গন্ধ গোরা-অঙ্গের বাতাস ।
কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—তোমার কপট সন্ন্যাস ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

adbhuta gandha gorā-aṅgera bātāsa |
kṛṣṇadāsa bole—tomāra kapaṭa sannyāsa || 246 ||

adbhuta gandha — a wondrous fragrance; gora-angera batasa — the breeze from Gora's body; krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; tomara kapata sannyasa — Your sannyasa is a disguise

246From Gora's body blows a breeze of wondrous fragrance.
Krishnadasa says: "Your sannyasa is only a disguise"10.

দণ্ডবত করে ভূমে, স্তব্ধ হঞা রহে ।
কহ কহ কহ—গৌর কৃষ্ণদাসে কহে ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

daṇḍabata kare bhūme, stabdha hañā rahe |
kaha kaha kaha—gaura kṛṣṇadāse kahe || 247 ||

dandavata kare bhume — he prostrates on the ground; stabdha hanya rahe — remains motionless; kaha kaha kaha — "speak, speak, speak"; gaura krishnadase kahe — Gaura says to Krishnadasa

247He prostrates on the ground and remains motionless.
"Speak, speak, speak!" Gaura says to Krishnadasa.

কৃষ্ণদাস বোলে—গোসাঞি, শুনহ বচনে ।
রাসক্রীড়া কৈল কৃষ্ণ এই বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

kṛṣṇadāsa bole—gosāñi, śunaha bacane |
rāsakrīṛā kaila kṛṣṇa ei bṛndābane || 248 ||

krishnadasa bole — Krishnadasa says; gosani shunaha vachane — Gosani, hear the word; rasa-krida kaila krishna — Krishna performed the rasa play; ei vrindavane — in this Vrindavana

248Krishnadasa says: "Gosani, listen:
in this Vrindavana Krishna performed the rasa play.

এই কল্পতরু-মূলে পূরে বংশীনাদ ।
ষোলক্রোশ পথে গোপীর ভেল উনমাদ ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

ei kalpataru-mūle pūre baṃśīnāda |
ṣolakrośa pathe gopīra bhela unamāda || 249 ||

ei kalpataru-mule — at the foot of this wish-fulfilling tree; pure vamshi-nada — He fills [the air] with the flute's sound; shola-krosha pathe — over sixteen kroshas; gopira bhela unamada — the gopis went mad

249At the foot of this wish-fulfilling tree He played the flute —
and for sixteen kroshas around the gopis went mad.

বিগত-চেতন গোপী কৃষ্ণ-আকর্ষণে ।
উপেখিল কুল-শীল-লাজ-ভয় মানে ॥ ২৫০ ॥

bigata-cetana gopī kṛṣṇa-ākarṣaṇe |
upekhila kula-śīla-lāja-bhaẏa māne || 250 ||

vigata-chetana gopi — the gopis, beside themselves; krishna-akarshane — by Krishna's attraction; upekhila — disregarded; kula-shila-laja-bhaya mane — family, good conduct, shame, fear and honour

250Drawn by Krishna, the gopis lost their senses
and disregarded family, good conduct, shame, fear and honour.

ব্যস্ত-বস্ত্র-আভরণ হৈল সভাকার ।
কৃষ্ণগত-চিত্তবৃত্তি মদন-ঝঙ্কার ॥ ২৫১ ॥

byasta-bastra-ābharaṇa haila sabhākāra |
kṛṣṇagata-cittabṛtti madana-jhaṅkāra || 251 ||

vyasta-vastra-abharana — clothes and ornaments in disarray; haila sabhakara — were with all of them; krishna-gata-chitta-vritti — their thoughts gone to Krishna; madana-jhankara — the ringing [call] of Madana

251All of them had their clothes and ornaments in disarray,
all their thoughts gone to Krishna, the call of Madana ringing in their hearts.

অপ্রাকৃত-কামেতে মুগধ ব্রজবালা ।
কৃষ্ণের নিকটে আসি' সভাই মিলিলা ॥ ২৫২ ॥

aprākṛta-kāmete mugadha brajabālā |
kṛṣṇera nikaṭe āsi' sabhāi mililā || 252 ||

aprakrita-kamete — by transcendental "kama" (love); mugadha vraja-bala — the enchanted maidens of Vraja; krishnera nikate asi — coming to Krishna; sabhai milila — all gathered

252Enchanted by transcendental love11, the maidens of Vraja
came to Krishna and all gathered together.

এইখানে দেখ বামে এ গোবিন্দরায় ।
শুনিমাত্র গোরাচান্দ বিভোর হিয়ায় ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

eikhāne dekha bāme e gobindarāẏa |
śunimātra gorācānda bibhora hiẏāẏa || 253 ||

eikhane dekha vame — here, see, on the left; e govinda-raya — this Govindaraya; shunimatra gorachanda — as soon as He heard, Gorachand; vibhora hiyaya — rapt in heart

253Here, see, on the left — this Govindaraya"12.
As soon as He heard this, Gorachand was rapt in heart.

হইল আবেশ পুনঃ, পরবশ অঙ্গ ।
এ ভূমি-আকাশ জোড়ে প্রেমের তরঙ্গ ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

haila ābeśa punaḥ, parabaśa aṅga |
e bhūmi-ākāśa joṛe premera taraṅga || 254 ||

haila avesha punah — ecstasy came again; paravasha anga — His body overpowered; e bhumi-akasha jode — fill earth and sky; premera taranga — waves of prema

254Ecstasy came again; His body was not His own;
waves of prema fill earth and sky.

হুহুঙ্কার-নাদে রস-অমিয়া বরষে ।
পশু-পক্ষী উনমাদ মদন-হরিষে ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

huhuṅkāra-nāde rasa-amiẏā baraṣe |
paśu-pakṣī unamāda madana-hariṣe || 255 ||

huhunkara-nade — with thunderous roars; rasa-amiya varishe — He rains the nectar of rasa; pashu-pakshi unamada — beasts and birds go mad; madana-harishe — in the joy of love

255With thunderous roars He rains the nectar of rasa;
beasts and birds go mad with the joy of love.

অকালে পুষ্পিত ভেল সব তরুবর ।
কোকিল সুস্বর-নাদে, মাতিল ভ্রমর ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

akāle puṣpita bhela saba tarubara |
kokila susbara-nāde, mātila bhramara || 256 ||

akale pushpita bhela — blossomed out of season; saba taruvara — all the fine trees; kokila susvara-nade — the cuckoos sing sweetly; matila bhramara — the bees grew intoxicated

256All the trees blossomed out of season,
the cuckoos sing sweetly, the bees grew intoxicated.

বংশী বলি' ডাকে প্রভু রাস প্রশংসিয়া ।
ভালি রে ভালি রে বোলে মুচকি হাসিয়া ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

baṃśī bali' ḍāke prabhu rāsa praśaṃsiẏā |
bhāli re bhāli re bole mucaki hāsiẏā || 257 ||

vamshi bali dake — He calls, crying "the flute!"; prabhu — the Lord; rasa prashamsiya — praising the rasa; bhali re bhali re bole — says "splendid, splendid!"; muchaki hasiya — smiling gently

257The Lord calls, crying "The flute!", and, praising the rasa,
says with a gentle smile: "Splendid, splendid!"

কোন গোপী বোলে—তোরা রহ এইখানে ।
কেহো কথা কহে যেন নিদের স্বপনে ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

kona gopī bole—torā raha eikhāne |
keho kathā kahe yena nidera sbapane || 258 ||

kona gopi bole — some gopi says; tora raha eikhane — you stay here; keho katha kahe — someone speaks; yena nidera svapane — as if in a dream

258Now, [like] some gopi, He says: "You stay here!" —
now He speaks [like] someone in a dream13.

ক্ষণেকে চমকি' নিজ অঙ্গ করে কোলে ।
দ্রবময় ভেল দেহ—সব অঙ্গ ঝরে ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

kṣaṇeke camaki' nija aṅga kare kole |
drabamaẏa bhela deha—saba aṅga jhare || 259 ||

kshaneke chamaki — suddenly startled; nija anga kare kole — He embraces His own body; drava-maya bhela deha — His body seemed to melt; saba anga jhare — all His limbs stream

259Now, suddenly startled, He embraces His own body;
His body seemed to melt, all His limbs streaming.

ক্ষণে বাল্যাবেশে নাচে অট্ট-অট্ট হাস ।
বিহ্বল চরণে পড়ি' কান্দে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ২৬০ ॥

kṣaṇe bālyābeśe nāce aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa |
bihbala caraṇe paṛi' kānde kṛṣṇadāsa || 260 ||

kshane balya-aveshe — now in a childlike rapture; nache atta-atta hasa — He dances with loud laughter; vihvala charane padi — overwhelmed, falling at His feet; kande krishnadasa — Krishnadasa weeps

260Now in a childlike rapture He dances with loud laughter;
Krishnadasa, overwhelmed, weeps, fallen at His feet:

মোর ভাগ্যে তিনলোকে নাহি কোন জন ।
বড় ভাগ্যে পাইলুঁ মুঞি হারাইলুঁ ধন ॥ ২৬১ ॥

mora bhāgye tinaloke nāhi kona jana |
baṛa bhāgye pāiluṁ muñi hārāiluṁ dhana || 261 ||

mora bhagye — with fortune like mine; tina-loke nahi kona jana — there is no one in the three worlds; bada bhagye — by great fortune; pailun munyi — I have found; harailun dhana — my lost treasure

261"There is no one in the three worlds with fortune like mine:
by great fortune I have found my lost treasure!"

এ বোল বলিতে প্রভুর বাহ্য হৈল যবে ।
কহ, কৃষ্ণদাসে পুছে—কি হৈল তবে ॥ ২৬২ ॥

e bola balite prabhura bāhya haila yabe |
kaha, kṛṣṇadāse puche—ki haila tabe || 262 ||

e bola balite — as he said this; prabhura bahya haila yabe — when the Lord's outer awareness returned; kaha — tell; krishnadase puchhe — He asks Krishnadasa; ki haila tabe — what happened then

262When at these words the Lord's outer awareness returned,
He asks Krishnadasa: "Tell Me, what happened then?"

এইখানে গোপীকে বুঝায় কুলাচার ।
গোপীর নিগূঢ় ভক্তিভাব বুঝিবার ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

eikhāne gopīke bujhāẏa kulācāra |
gopīra nigūṛha bhaktibhāba bujhibāra || 263 ||

eikhane — here; gopike bujhaya kulachara — He explains family duty to the gopis; gopira nigudha bhakti-bhava — the gopis' hidden devotion; bujhibara — in order to discern

263"Here [Krishna] instructs the gopis about duty to family —
to discern the gopis' hidden devotion,

কিম্বা অনুরাগ বৃদ্ধি করিবার তরে ।
রস-পরিপাটী ভাব বাড়ায় অন্তরে ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

kimbā anurāga bṛddhi karibāra tare |
rasa-paripāṭī bhāba bāṛāẏa antare || 264 ||

kimva — or else; anuraga vriddhi karibara tare — in order to increase their love; rasa-paripati — in the proper course of rasa; bhava badaya antare — He heightens the bhava in [their] hearts

264or to increase their love:
He heightens the bhava in their hearts in the proper course of rasa14.

সুমধ্যমাগণ, কেনে রাত্রে কুঞ্জমাঝে ।
ভয় না করিলে, এথা আইলে কোন্ কাজে ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

sumadhyamāgaṇa, kene rātre kuñjamājhe |
bhaẏa nā karile, ethā āile kon kāje || 265 ||

sumadhyama-gana — O slender-waisted ones; kene ratre kunja-majhe — why at night into the grove; bhaya na karile — you were not afraid; etha aile kon kaje — for what purpose have you come here

265'O slender-waisted ones, why are you in the grove at night?
You were not afraid — why have you come here?

পরপতি-লালস-পরাণ হেতু তোরা ।
পরনারী-দরশ-পরশ নাহি মোরা ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

parapati-lālasa-parāṇa hetu torā |
paranārī-daraśa-paraśa nāhi morā || 266 ||

para-pati-lalasa-parana — your hearts longing for another's husband; hetu tora — for that you [came]; para-nari-darasha-parasha — looking at and touching others' wives; nahi mora — is not for us

266Your hearts long for another's husband — that is why [you came];
but I do not look at other men's wives or touch them.

আপনার ঘরে গিয়া পতি-সেবা কর ।
নারী নিজপতি ভজে—এই ধর্মসার ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

āpanāra ghare giẏā pati-sebā kara |
nārī nijapati bhaje—ei dharmasāra || 267 ||

apanara ghare giya — going to your homes; pati-seva kara — serve your husbands; nari nija-pati bhaje — a woman serves her own husband; ei dharma-sara — this is the essence of dharma

267Go home and serve your husbands:
a wife serves her own husband — this is the essence of dharma.

কিবা রুগ্ন কিবা বৃদ্ধ দরিদ্র কুরূপ ।
নিজপতি-সেবা পরধর্মের স্বরূপ ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

kibā rugna kibā bṛddha daridra kurūpa |
nijapati-sebā paradharmera sbarūpa || 268 ||

kiba rugna kiba vriddha — be he sick or old; daridra kurupa — poor or ugly; nija-pati-seva — service to one's own husband; para-dharmera svarupa — the very form of the highest dharma

268Be he sick or old, poor or ugly —
service to one's own husband is the very form of the highest dharma.

চল চল নিজগৃহে, চল ব্রজবালা ।
সতী নাহি করে নিজধর্মে অবহেলা ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

cala cala nijagṛhe, cala brajabālā |
satī nāhi kare nijadharme abahelā || 269 ||

chala chala nija-grihe — go, go to your homes; chala vraja-bala — go, maidens of Vraja; sati nahi kare — a chaste wife does not show; nija-dharme avahela — neglect of her own duty

269Go, go home, go, maidens of Vraja:
a chaste wife does not neglect her duty.

আমি মহাধর্ম, কভু না করি অধর্ম ।
না বুঝি' আমার মন কৈলে কোন্ কর্ম ॥ ২৭০ ॥

āmi mahādharma, kabhu nā kari adharma |
nā bujhi' āmāra mana kaile kon karma || 270 ||

ami mahadharma — I [keep] the great dharma; kabhu na kari adharma — I never commit unrighteousness; na bujhi amara mana — without understanding My mind; kaile kon karma — what have you done

270I keep the great dharma and never act unrighteously;
not understanding My heart, what have you done?'

শুনিঞা রমণীগণ হৈলা মূর্ছিতে ।
স্তব্ধ হইয়া রহে যেন চিত্র রহে ভিতে ॥ ২৭১ ॥

śuniñā ramaṇīgaṇa hailā mūrchite |
stabdha haiẏā rahe yena citra rahe bhite || 271 ||

shuninya — hearing; ramanigana haila murchhite — the women swooned; stabdha haiya rahe — they stand motionless; yena chitra rahe bhite — like pictures on a wall

271Hearing this, the maidens swooned;
they stood motionless, like pictures on a wall.

অল্প অল্প শ্বাস হৈল, বাক্য নাহি কারে ।
মদন-জ্বরেতে জারিলেক কলেবরে ॥ ২৭২ ॥

alpa alpa śbāsa haila, bākya nāhi kāre |
madana-jbarete jārileka kalebare || 272 ||

alpa alpa shvasa haila — their breathing grew faint; vakya nahi kare — none had words; madana-jvarete — by the fever of love; jarileka kalevare — their bodies were consumed

272Their breathing grew faint, none had words;
the fever of love consumed their bodies.

কভু ঘন শ্বাস হয় বিরহের তাপে ।
কভু নেত্র ঝরে, কভু সর্ব অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

kabhu ghana śbāsa haẏa birahera tāpe |
kabhu netra jhare, kabhu sarba aṅga kāṁpe || 273 ||

kabhu ghana shvasa haya — now their breath comes fast; virahera tape — from the heat of separation; kabhu netra jhare — now their eyes stream; kabhu sarva anga kanpe — now their whole body trembles

273Now their breath comes fast from the heat of separation,
now their eyes stream, now their whole body trembles.

কভু কভু কৃষ্ণপানে থির-দিঠে চাহে ।
কভু কভু মদন-ভাবেতে থির নহে ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

kabhu kabhu kṛṣṇapāne thira-diṭhe cāhe |
kabhu kabhu madana-bhābete thira nahe || 274 ||

kabhu kabhu krishna-pane — sometimes at Krishna; thira-dithe chahe — they gaze with a fixed look; kabhu kabhu madana-bhavete — sometimes from love's emotion; thira nahe — they are not still

274Sometimes they gaze fixedly at Krishna,
sometimes, from love's emotion, they cannot be still.

ভাব-ভরে কি বোল বলিতে কিবা কহে ।
সভার মনের কথা আপনে কহয়ে ॥ ২৭৫ ॥

bhāba-bhare ki bola balite kibā kahe |
sabhāra manera kathā āpane kahaẏe || 275 ||

bhava-bhare — overwhelmed by feeling; ki bola balite kiba kahe — meaning to say one thing they say another; sabhara manera katha — what is in all their hearts; apane kahaye — they themselves speak

275Overwhelmed by feeling, meaning to say one thing they say another,
and themselves speak what is in all their hearts:

জগত-মোহন করে যার রূপ-গুণে ।
অবলা ধৈরজ তবে ধরিব কেমনে ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

jagata-mohana kare yāra rūpa-guṇe |
abalā dhairaja tabe dhariba kemane || 276 ||

jagata-mohana kare — enchant the world; yara rupa-gune — whose beauty and qualities; abala — [we] weak women; dhairaja tabe dhariba kemane — how then shall we keep our composure

276'He whose beauty and qualities enchant the world —
how then can we weak women keep our composure?

মোরা কুলবতী—কুলব্রত মাত্র জানি ।
কুলব্রত-ভঙ্গ কৈল মুরলীর ধ্বনি ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

morā kulabatī—kulabrata mātra jāni |
kulabrata-bhaṅga kaila muralīra dhbani || 277 ||

mora kulavati — we are women of good families; kulavrata matra jani — we know only the vow of family [fidelity]; kulavrata-bhanga kaila — broke that vow; muralira dhvani — the sound of the flute

277We are women of good families; we know only the vow of fidelity to family;
but the sound of the flute has broken that vow.

তুমি কিছু নাহি জান, মোরা নাহি জানি ।
জগত-মোহন-গুণে আনিলা রমণী ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

tumi kichu nāhi jāna, morā nāhi jāni |
jagata-mohana-guṇe ānilā ramaṇī || 278 ||

tumi kichhu nahi jana — You [seem to] know nothing; mora nahi jani — we do not know; jagata-mohana-gune — by Your world-enchanting qualities; anila ramani — You drew the women here

278You seem to know nothing — and we [ourselves] do not know [how we came]:
by Your world-enchanting qualities You have drawn the women here.

পতির পরম পতি—তুমি আত্মারাম ।
তোমারে ছাড়িলে পতি অগতি প্রমাণ ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

patira parama pati—tumi ātmārāma |
tomāre chāṛile pati agati pramāṇa || 279 ||

patira parama pati — the supreme Husband of husbands; tumi atmarama — You are the Atmarama; tomare chhadile — if one leaves You; pati agati pramana — a husband is proven to be no refuge

279You are the supreme Husband of [all] husbands, You are the Atmarama;
if one leaves You, a husband is no refuge — this is proven.

মোর আত্মারাম তুমি, রমহ আমাতে ।
তবে পরপতি কোথা দেখিলে ভজিতে ॥ ২৮০ ॥

mora ātmārāma tumi, ramaha āmāte |
tabe parapati kothā dekhile bhajite || 280 ||

mora atmarama tumi — You are the delight of our soul; ramaha amate — take Your delight in us; tabe — then; para-pati kotha dekhile bhajite — where did You see [us] serving another's husband

280You are the delight of our soul; take Your delight in us;
where did You see us serving another's husband?15

অহে পতি-গতি, পতি সভার আশ্রয় ।
আনন্দ পরমানন্দ সর্বসুখময় ॥ ২৮১ ॥

ahe pati-gati, pati sabhāra āśraẏa |
ānanda paramānanda sarbasukhamaẏa || 281 ||

ahe pati-gati — O refuge of husbands; pati sabhara ashraya — Husband, the shelter of all; ananda paramananda — bliss, supreme bliss; sarva-sukha-maya — full of every joy

281O refuge of husbands, Husband, shelter of all,
bliss, supreme bliss, full of every joy!'

ভাব-ভরে ভাবিনীগণ সত্য কহে ।
ভাবকথা শুনি' কৃষ্ণ হৈলা ভাবময়ে ॥ ২৮২ ॥

bhāba-bhare bhābinīgaṇa satya kahe |
bhābakathā śuni' kṛṣṇa hailā bhābamaẏe || 282 ||

bhava-bhare — overflowing with feeling; bhavinigana satya kahe — the loving maidens speak the truth; bhava-katha shuni — hearing these words of love; krishna haila bhavamaye — Krishna was filled with feeling

282Overflowing with feeling, the loving maidens speak the truth;
hearing these words of love, Krishna was filled with feeling.

চাহিলা সরস-হাস্যে সব গোপী-পানে ।
যত সুখ গোপী পাইল—কেহো নাহি জানে ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

cāhilā sarasa-hāsye saba gopī-pāne |
yata sukha gopī pāila—keho nāhi jāne || 283 ||

chahila sarasa-hasye — He looked with a tender smile; saba gopi-pane — at all the gopis; yata sukha gopi paila — how much joy the gopis found; keho nahi jane — no one knows

283He looked with a tender smile at all the gopis —
how much joy the gopis found no one knows.

বেড়িলেক সব গোপী প্রভু যদুমণি ।
মেঘেতে ঝলকে যেন থির-সৌদামিনী ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

beṛileka saba gopī prabhu yadumaṇi |
meghete jhalake yena thira-saudāminī || 284 ||

bedileka saba gopi — all the gopis surrounded; prabhu yadumani — the Lord, jewel of the Yadus; meghete jhalake — flashes in a cloud; yena thira-saudamini — like steady lightning

284All the gopis surrounded the Lord, the jewel of the Yadus,
like steady lightning flashing in a cloud.

এইখানে অপরূপ এ রাসবিহার ।
এক গোপী এক কৃষ্ণ মণ্ডলী তাহার ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

eikhāne aparūpa e rāsabihāra |
eka gopī eka kṛṣṇa maṇḍalī tāhāra || 285 ||

eikhane — here; aparupa e rasa-vihara — this wondrous rasa play; eka gopi eka krishna — one gopi, one Krishna; mandali tahara — such was its circle

285Here took place this wondrous rasa play:
one gopi, one Krishna — such was its circle.

কনক-চম্পক আর মরকত-মণি ।
গাঁথিল যেমন মালা, মণ্ডলী তেমনি ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

kanaka-campaka āra marakata-maṇi |
gāṁthila yemana mālā, maṇḍalī temani || 286 ||

kanaka-champaka — golden champakas; ara marakata-mani — and emeralds; ganthila yemana mala — like a strung garland; mandali temani — so was the circle

286Like a garland strung of golden champakas and emeralds —
so was the circle.

যত গোপী তত কৃষ্ণ এ রাসমণ্ডলে ।
পড়িল রাসের হাট বৃন্দাবন-স্থলে ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

yata gopī tata kṛṣṇa e rāsamaṇḍale |
paṛila rāsera hāṭa bṛndābana-sthale || 287 ||

yata gopi tata krishna — as many gopis, so many Krishnas; e rasa-mandale — in this rasa circle; padila rasera hata — the market of the rasa opened; vrindavana-sthale — on the ground of Vrindavana

287As many gopis, so many Krishnas in this rasa circle:
on the ground of Vrindavana the market of the rasa opened.

কল্পবৃক্ষ-স্থানে রাধাকৃষ্ণ দুইজন ।
গোপীর অংশিনী রাধা রসের কারণ ॥ ২৮৮ ॥

kalpabṛkṣa-sthāne rādhākṛṣṇa duijana |
gopīra aṃśinī rādhā rasera kāraṇa || 288 ||

kalpavriksha-sthane — at the wish-fulfilling tree; radha-krishna duijana — the two, Radha and Krishna; gopira amshini radha — Radha, the source of [all] the gopis; rasera karana — the cause of rasa

288At the wish-fulfilling tree are the two, Radha and Krishna:
Radha, the source of [all] the gopis, the cause of rasa16.

কৃষ্ণ হৈতে কৃষ্ণ তথা হইল অপার ।
যত রাধা তত কৃষ্ণ হৈল এ বিচার ॥ ২৮৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa haite kṛṣṇa tathā haila apāra |
yata rādhā tata kṛṣṇa haila e bicāra || 289 ||

krishna haite krishna — Krishna from Krishna; tatha haila apara — appeared there without end; yata radha tata krishna — as many Radhas, so many Krishnas; haila e vichara — such was the arrangement

289From Krishna there appeared Krishnas without end:
as many Radhas, so many Krishnas — such was the arrangement.

রাস-হাট-উপরে পতাকা শশধরে ।
কোকিল কোটাল হঞা জাগায় কামেরে ॥ ২৯০ ॥

rāsa-hāṭa-upare patākā śaśadhare |
kokila koṭāla hañā jāgāẏa kāmere || 290 ||

rasa-hata-upare — above the market of the rasa; pataka shashadhare — the moon is the banner; kokila kotala hanya — the cuckoo, as watchman; jagaya kamere — awakens Kama

290Over the market of the rasa the moon is the banner;
the cuckoo, as watchman, awakens Kama.

ভ্রমরা হাটের বাদ্য, পসার যৌবন ।
গ্রাহক রসিকবর মদনমোহন ॥ ২৯১ ॥

bhramarā hāṭera bādya, pasāra yaubana |
grāhaka rasikabara madanamohana || 291 ||

bhramara hatera vadya — the bees are the market's music; pasara yauvana — the wares are youth; grahaka — the buyer; rasikavara madana-mohana — the best of connoisseurs of rasa, Madana-mohana

291The bees are the market's music, the wares are youth,
the buyer is the best of connoisseurs of rasa, Madana-mohana.

গোপিকার শুদ্ধ প্রেম জানিঞা শ্রীহরি ।
ভকত-বশ্যতা-গুণ প্রকাশ সে করি' ॥ ২৯২ ॥

gopikāra śuddha prema jāniñā śrīhari |
bhakata-baśyatā-guṇa prakāśa se kari' || 292 ||

gopikara shuddha prema — the gopis' pure prema; janinya srihari — knowing, Sri Hari; bhakata-vashyata-guna — His quality of being subject to His devotees; prakasha se kari — revealing

292Knowing the gopis' pure prema, Sri Hari
reveals His quality of being subject to His devotees.

যূথে যূথে পাটোয়ার নটিনী গোপিনী ।
নাটুয়া তাহার মাঝে প্রভু যদুমণি ॥ ২৯৩ ॥

yūthe yūthe pāṭoẏāra naṭinī gopinī |
nāṭuẏā tāhāra mājhe prabhu yadumaṇi || 293 ||

yuthe yuthe — in groups; patoyara natini gopini — the gopis are skilled dancers; natuya tahara majhe — the dancer in their midst; prabhu yadumani — the Lord, jewel of the Yadus

293In groups are the gopis, skilled dancers,
and the dancer in their midst is the Lord, the jewel of the Yadus.

বলয়া-নূপুর-মণি-কিঙ্কিণীর রোল ।
মুরলী-মধুরধ্বনি তাহাতে উজোর ॥ ২৯৪ ॥

balaẏā-nūpura-maṇi-kiṅkiṇīra rola |
muralī-madhuradhbani tāhāte ujora || 294 ||

valaya-nupura-mani-kinkinira rola — the jingling of bangles, anklets, jewels and belts of bells; murali-madhura-dhvani — the sweet sound of the flute; tahate ujora — rings out bright among them

294Bangles, anklets, jewels and belts of bells jingle;
among them the sweet voice of the flute rings out bright.

রবাব উপাঙ্গ স্বরমণ্ডলের গান ।
মৃদঙ্গ মন্দিরা ডম্ফ পাখোয়াজ সুতান ॥ ২৯৫ ॥

rabāba upāṅga sbaramaṇḍalera gāna |
mṛdaṅga mandirā ḍampha pākhoẏāja sutāna || 295 ||

rababa upanga — the rabab, the upanga; svaramandalera gana — the song of the svaramandala; mridanga mandira dampha — mridanga, mandira (cymbals), dampha; pakhoyaja sutana — pakhavaj — sweet melodies

295Rabab, upanga, the song of the svaramandala,
mridanga, mandira cymbals, dampha, pakhavaj — sweet melodies.

আর অপরূপ হের দেখ সেইখানে ।
রাই-রাজা কৈল কৃষ্ণ এই বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৯৬ ॥

āra aparūpa hera dekha seikhāne |
rāi-rājā kaila kṛṣṇa ei bṛndābane || 296 ||

ara aparupa — another wonder; hera dekha seikhane — here, see, at that place; rai-raja kaila krishna — Krishna made Rai sovereign; ei vrindavane — in this Vrindavana

296And another wonder — here, see, at that place:
in this Vrindavana Krishna made Rai sovereign.

দিব্য চন্দন-মালা দিল রাধার অঙ্গে ।
আপনে করয়ে স্তুতি গোপীগণ-সঙ্গে ॥ ২৯৭ ॥

dibya candana-mālā dila rādhāra aṅge |
āpane karaẏe stuti gopīgaṇa-saṅge || 297 ||

divya chandana-mala — divine sandal and garland; dila radhara ange — He placed on Radha; apane karaye stuti — He Himself offers praise; gopigana-sange — together with the gopis

297He placed divine sandal and a garland on Radha
and Himself praises Her together with the gopis.

অভিষেক করি' কহে—শুন গোপীগণে ।
আজি হৈতে রাধা রাজা হৈল বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ২৯৮ ॥

abhiṣeka kari' kahe—śuna gopīgaṇe |
āji haite rādhā rājā haila bṛndābane || 298 ||

abhisheka kari — performing the anointing; kahe — He says; shuna gopigane — listen, gopis; aji haite — from today; radha raja haila vrindavane — Radha is sovereign in Vrindavana

298Having anointed Her, He says: 'Listen, gopis:
from today Radha is sovereign in Vrindavana'17.

হেনমতে রাসে বিহরয়ে যদুরায় ।
আচম্বিতে সব গোপী দেখিতে না পায় ॥ ২৯৯ ॥

henamate rāse biharaẏe yadurāẏa |
ācambite saba gopī dekhite nā pāẏa || 299 ||

henamate — thus; rase viharaye yaduraya — the King of the Yadus sports in the rasa; achambite — suddenly; saba gopi dekhite na paya — none of the gopis can see [Him]

299Thus the King of the Yadus sports in the rasa —
and suddenly none of the gopis can see Him.

এক গোপী লঞা গেলা সভারে এড়িয়া ।
কান্দয়ে এখানে গোপী অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩০০ ॥

eka gopī lañā gelā sabhāre eṛiẏā |
kāndaẏe ekhāne gopī aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 300 ||

eka gopi lanya gela — He went away taking one gopi; sabhare ediya — leaving all; kandaye ekhane gopi — here the gopis weep; anga achhadiya — flinging themselves [down]

300Leaving them all, He went away taking one gopi with Him18;
here the gopis weep, flinging themselves on the ground.

তুলসী মালতী যূথী, তোমারে সুধাই ।
এ পথে দেখেছ যেতে হলধরের ভাই ॥ ৩০০+১ ॥

tulasī mālatī yūthī, tomāre sudhāi |
e pathe dekhecha yete haladharera bhāi || 300+1 ||

tulasi malati yuthi — tulasi, malati, yuthi; tomare sudhai — I ask you; e pathe dekhechha yete — have you seen going by this path; haladharera bhai — the brother of Haladhara

300+1'Tulasi, malati, yuthi, I ask you:
have you seen Haladhara's brother going by this path?19

কৃষ্ণের চরণাশ্রিতা তুলসী কল্যাণী ।
তুমি দেখিয়াছ কৃষ্ণ প্রাণ যদুমণি ॥ ৩০০+২ ॥

kṛṣṇera caraṇāśritā tulasī kalyāṇī |
tumi dekhiẏācha kṛṣṇa prāṇa yadumaṇi || 300+2 ||

krishnera charana-ashrita — sheltered at Krishna's feet; tulasi kalyani — auspicious tulasi; tumi dekhiyachha — you have seen; krishna prana yadumani — Krishna, [our] life, the jewel of the Yadus

300+2Auspicious tulasi, sheltered at Krishna's feet,
have you seen Krishna, our life, the jewel of the Yadus?

কে মোর হরিয়া নিল নীলমণি কালা ।
গহন কাননে ফিরে আহীরীর বালা ॥ ৩০০+৩ ॥

ke mora hariẏā nila nīlamaṇi kālā |
gahana kānane phire āhīrīra bālā || 300+3 ||

ke mora hariya nila — who has stolen from me; nilamani kala — the dark sapphire; gahana kanane phire — wander in the deep forest; ahirira bala — the cowherd girls

300+3Who has stolen my dark sapphire?' —
the cowherd girls wander in the deep forest.

রামানুজ আমা সবার গর্ব সে জানিয়া ।
মন-হরি কোথা গেলা সবারে ছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩০০+৪ ॥

rāmānuja āmā sabāra garba se jāniẏā |
mana-hari kothā gelā sabāre chāṛiẏā || 300+4 ||

ramanuja — Rama's younger brother; ama sabara garva se janiya — knowing the pride of us all; mana-hari — the stealer of hearts; kotha gela sabare chhadiya — where has He gone, leaving us all

300+4'Rama's younger brother, knowing our pride —
the stealer of hearts — where has He gone, leaving us all?

শুন শুন ওরে তুমি যূথিকা মল্লিকা ।
কদম্ব, দেখেছ কৃষ্ণ?—পুছে গোপিকা ॥ ৩০০+৫ ॥

śuna śuna ore tumi yūthikā mallikā |
kadamba, dekhecha kṛṣṇa?—puche gopikā || 300+5 ||

shuna shuna ore tumi — listen, O you; yuthika mallika — yuthika, mallika; kadamba — kadamba; dekhechha krishna — have you seen Krishna?; puchhe gopika — the gopis ask

300+5Listen, O yuthika and mallika!
Kadamba, have you seen Krishna?' the gopis ask.

না পাইয়া লাগি তার যত গোপীগণ ।
কৃষ্ণের যতেক লীলা করয়ে রচন ॥ ৩০০+৬ ॥

nā pāiẏā lāgi tāra yata gopīgaṇa |
kṛṣṇera yateka līlā karaẏe racana || 300+6 ||

na paiya — not finding [Him]; lagi tara — for His sake; yata gopigana — all the gopis; krishnera yateka lila — all of Krishna's lilas; karaye rachana — enact

300+6Not finding Him, all the gopis, for His sake,
enact all of Krishna's lilas:

কেহো ত পূতনা হৈলা, কেহো হৈলা কান ।
স্তন পান করি' কেহো বধিল পরাণ ॥ ৩০০+৭ ॥

keho ta pūtanā hailā, keho hailā kāna |
stana pāna kari' keho badhila parāṇa || 300+7 ||

keho ta putana haila — one became Putana; keho haila kana — another became Kana (Krishna); stana pana kari — sucking the breast; keho vadhila parana — took [her] life

300+7one became Putana, another became Kana
and, sucking at the breast, took the other's life;

কোনো সখী আইলা শকট-রূপ ধরি' ।
কৃষ্ণ-রূপ ধরি' কেহো তাহারে সংহারি ॥ ৩০০+৮ ॥

kono sakhī āilā śakaṭa-rūpa dhari' |
kṛṣṇa-rūpa dhari' keho tāhāre saṃhāri || 300+8 ||

kono sakhi aila — one friend came; shakata-rupa dhari — taking the form of the cart; krishna-rupa dhari — taking Krishna's form; keho tahare samhari — another destroyed her

300+8one friend came in the form of the cart,
and another, taking Krishna's form, destroyed her;

অঘ বক হৈয়া তবে কোনো সখী আইলা ।
কৃষ্ণরূপ হৈয়া কেহো তাহারে মারিলা ॥ ৩০০+৯ ॥

agha baka haiẏā tabe kono sakhī āilā |
kṛṣṇarūpa haiẏā keho tāhāre mārilā || 300+9 ||

agha baka haiya — becoming Agha, Baka; tabe kono sakhi aila — then one friend came; krishna-rupa haiya — becoming Krishna; keho tahare marila — another slew her

300+9then one friend came as Agha and Baka,
and another, as Krishna, slew her.

সঙ্গের গোপিকা সেই আদরেই ভর ।
হাসিয়া কহয়ে—মুঞি চলিতে কাতর ॥ ৩০১ ॥

saṅgera gopikā sei ādarei bhara |
hāsiẏā kahaẏe—muñi calite kātara || 301 ||

sangera gopika sei — that gopi who was with Him; adarei bhara — leaning on His fondness; hasiya kahaye — says smiling; munyi chalite katara — I am too weary to walk

301And the gopi who was with Him, leaning on His fondness,
says with a smile: 'I am too weary to walk;

যেনমতে পার তেনমতে লহ তুমি ।
কানু কহে—আইস, কান্ধে করি' নিব আমি ॥ ৩০২ ॥

yenamate pāra tenamate laha tumi |
kānu kahe—āisa, kāndhe kari' niba āmi || 302 ||

yenamate para — however You can; tenamate laha tumi — so carry [me]; kanu kahe — Kanu says; aisa — come; kandhe kari niba ami — I will carry [you] on My shoulders

302carry me however You can.' Kanu says:
'Come, I will carry you on My shoulders.'

মাতিল পাথার বুকে শীতল বনে ।
টানিয়া কাকালি বান্ধে নেতের বসনে ॥ ৩০২+১ ॥

mātila pāthāra buke śītala bane |
ṭāniẏā kākāli bāndhe netera basane || 302+1 ||

matila pathara buke — a sea [of joy] surged in her breast; shitala vane — in the cool forest; taniya — pulling tight; kakali bandhe — she girds her waist; netera vasane — with a silk cloth

302+1In the cool forest a sea [of joy] surged in her breast;
pulling her garment tight, she girds her waist with a silk cloth20.

কোলে করি' লঞা গেলা আর কথোদূর ।
আচম্বিতে তাহাকেও ভৈগেলা নিঠুর ॥ ৩০৩ ॥

kole kari' lañā gelā āra kathodūra |
ācambite tāhākeo bhaigelā niṭhura || 303 ||

kole kari lanya gela — taking her in His arms He carried her; ara kathodura — some distance further; achambite — suddenly; tahakeo bhaigela nithura — He became cruel to her too

and suddenly became cruel to her too21.

যে কালে চাপিবে কৃষ্ণের চূড়ায় দিয়া হাত ।
সেইকালে অন্তর্ধান কৈলা গোপীনাথ ॥ ৩০৩+১ ॥

ye kale chapibe — at the moment she was about to mount; krishnera chudaya diya hata — placing her hand on Krishna's crest; sei kale — at that very moment; antardhana kaila gopinatha — Gopinatha vanished

303+1At the moment when, placing her hand on Krishna's crest, she was about to mount [His shoulders], at that very moment Gopinatha vanished.

এইখানে অন্তর্ধান হৈলা তাহারে ।
ব্যাকুলিতা সেই গোপী কান্দে একেশ্বরে ॥ ৩০৪ ॥

eikhāne antardhāna hailā tāhāre |
byākulitā sei gopī kānde ekeśbare || 304 ||

eikhane — here; antardhana haila tahare — He vanished from her; vyakulita sei gopi — that gopi, distraught; kande ekeshvare — weeps alone

304Here He vanished from her,
and that gopi, distraught, weeps alone.

কৃষ্ণ হারাইয়া আর গোপী সব যত ।
এইখানে বুলে তারা চকিত উন্মত ॥ ৩০৫ ॥

kṛṣṇa hārāiẏā āra gopī saba yata |
eikhāne bule tārā cakita unmata || 305 ||

krishna haraiya — having lost Krishna; ara gopi saba yata — all the other gopis; eikhane bule tara — they wander here; chakita unmata — bewildered and frantic

305Having lost Krishna, all the other gopis
wander here, bewildered and frantic.

বিরহে ব্যাকুল গোপী কান্দে উভরায় ।
এ কথা শুনিতে দুঃখ বাঢ়য়ে হিয়ায় ॥ ৩০৬ ॥

birahe byākula gopī kānde ubharāẏa |
e kathā śunite duḥkha bāṛhaẏe hiẏāẏa || 306 ||

virahe vyakula gopi — the gopis, distraught in separation; kande ubharaya — weep aloud; e katha shunite — hearing this account; duhkha badhaye hiyaya — grief swells in the heart

306Distraught in separation, the gopis weep aloud;
hearing of it, grief swells in the heart.

ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে তবে আর গোপীগণ ।
দেখে রাধা প্রিয়সখী করিছে রোদন ॥ ৩০৬+১ ॥

bhramite bhramite tabe āra gopīgaṇa |
dekhe rādhā priẏasakhī kariche rodana || 306+1 ||

bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; tabe ara gopigana — then the other gopis; dekhe radha priya-sakhi — see Radha, [their] dear friend; karichhe rodana — weeping

306+1Wandering, the other gopis
see their dear friend Radha weeping22.

রাধা-দরশনে সবার শোক উথলিল ।
মিলি' আছাড়িয়া সবে কান্দিতে লাগিল ॥ ৩০৬+২ ॥

rādhā-daraśane sabāra śoka uthalila |
mili' āchāṛiẏā sabe kāndite lāgila || 306+2 ||

radha-darashane — at the sight of Radha; sabara shoka uthalila — the grief of all welled up; mili achhadiya — together flinging themselves [down]; sabe kandite lagila — all began to weep

306+2At the sight of Radha the grief of all welled up,
and all together, flinging themselves down, began to weep;

উনমতী হইলা সবে কাঁদিতে কাঁদিতে ।
মূর্ছিত হইয়া তারা পড়িল ভূমিতে ॥ ৩০৬+৩ ॥

unamatī hailā sabe kāṁdite kāṁdite |
mūrchita haiẏā tārā paṛila bhūmite || 306+3 ||

unamati haila sabe — all went mad; kandite kandite — weeping and weeping; murchhita haiya — swooning; tara padila bhumite — they fell to the ground

306+3weeping and weeping, all went mad
and, swooning, fell to the ground.

এইখানে গোপী কৃষ্ণ-চরিতে তন্ময় ।
যেখানে যে কৈল কৃষ্ণ তেনমত হয় ॥ ৩০৭ ॥

eikhāne gopī kṛṣṇa-carite tanmaẏa |
yekhāne ye kaila kṛṣṇa tenamata haẏa || 307 ||

eikhane — here; gopi krishna-charite tanmaya — the gopis are absorbed in Krishna's deeds; yekhane ye kaila krishna — whatever Krishna did wherever; tenamata haya — so they become

307Here the gopis are absorbed in Krishna's deeds:
whatever Krishna did wherever, so they do,

সেই অভিনয় করে, সেই সব রীত ।
উনমত গোপী সব কৃষ্ণময়-চিত ॥ ৩০৮ ॥

sei abhinaẏa kare, sei saba rīta |
unamata gopī saba kṛṣṇamaẏa-cita || 308 ||

sei abhinaya kare — they act that out; sei saba rita — all those same ways; unamata gopi saba — all the gopis maddened; krishnamaya-chita — their hearts full of Krishna

308acting out the same, all in just the same way —
all the gopis maddened, their hearts full of Krishna.

হেনমতে মূর্ছা যবে পাইল গোপীগণ ।
এইখানে কৃষ্ণ তবে দিল দরশন ॥ ৩০৯ ॥

henamate mūrchā yabe pāila gopīgaṇa |
eikhāne kṛṣṇa tabe dila daraśana || 309 ||

henamate — thus; murchha yabe paila gopigana — when the gopis swooned; eikhane — here; krishna tabe dila darashana — Krishna then appeared [to them]

309When the gopis thus swooned,
here Krishna then appeared to them23.

পুনরপি কৈল তবে এ রাস-বিলাস ।
পুনঃ রাসোৎসবে গোপী-আনন্দ-উল্লাস ॥ ৩১০ ॥

punarapi kaila tabe e rāsa-bilāsa |
punaḥ rāsotsabe gopī-ānanda-ullāsa || 310 ||

punarapi kaila tabe — then He again performed; e rasa-vilasa — this rasa play; punah rasotsave — again in the festival of the rasa; gopi-ananda-ullasa — the gopis' joy and delight

310And again He performed this rasa play,
and again, in the festival of the rasa, the gopis' joy and delight.

এইমতে আনন্দ-কৌতুকে রাত্রিশেষ ।
অলসে অবশ অঙ্গ, শ্লথ ভেল বেশ ॥ ৩১১ ॥

eimate ānanda-kautuke rātriśeṣa |
alase abaśa aṅga, ślatha bhela beśa || 311 ||

eimate — thus; ananda-kautuke — in joyful play; ratri-shesha — the night ended; alase avasha anga — their bodies limp with languor; shlatha bhela vesha — their attire loosened

311Thus in joyful play the night passed;
their bodies limp with languor, their attire loosened.

যমুনা-পুলিনে গেলা সব গোপী লঞা ।
গোপী-কোলে নিদ্রা যায় শ্রমযুক্ত হঞা ॥ ৩১২ ॥

yamunā-puline gelā saba gopī lañā |
gopī-kole nidrā yāẏa śramayukta hañā || 312 ||

yamuna-puline gela — He went to the bank of the Yamuna; saba gopi lanya — taking all the gopis; gopi-kole nidra yaya — He sleeps in the gopis' laps; shrama-yukta hanya — being weary

312Taking all the gopis, He went to the bank of the Yamuna
and, weary, slept in the gopis' laps.

এখানে যমুনাজল, সুশীতল বায় ।
কৃষ্ণ-কোলে সব গোপী সুখে নিদ্রা যায় ॥ ৩১৩ ॥

ekhāne yamunājala, suśītala bāẏa |
kṛṣṇa-kole saba gopī sukhe nidrā yāẏa || 313 ||

ekhane yamuna-jala — here the Yamuna's water; sushitala vaya — the cool breeze; krishna-kole saba gopi — all the gopis in Krishna's embrace; sukhe nidra yaya — sleep happily

313Here is the Yamuna's water, the cool breeze —
and all the gopis sleep happily in Krishna's embrace.

এইমতে শুভরাত্রি সুপ্রভাত হৈল ।
প্রণতি করিয়া গোপী নিজঘর গেল ॥ ৩১৪ ॥

eimate śubharātri suprabhāta haila |
praṇati kariẏā gopī nijaghara gela || 314 ||

eimate — thus; shubha-ratri — the auspicious night; suprabhata haila — turned into a bright morning; pranati kariya — bowing; gopi nija-ghara gela — the gopis went home

314Thus the auspicious night turned into a bright morning,
and the gopis bowed and went home."

এইমতে স্থানে স্থানে দেখে গোরারায় ।
আনন্দে লোচনদাস গোরাগুণ গায় ॥ ৩১৫ ॥

eimate sthāne sthāne dekhe gorārāẏa |
ānande locanadāsa gorāguṇa gāẏa || 315 ||

eimate — thus; sthane sthane — place after place; dekhe goraraya — Goraraya sees; anande lochanadasa — joyfully Lochana Dasa; goraguna gaya — sings Gora's glories

joyfully Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

Notes

  1. Vv. 206–210 follow the Bhagavata (10.22–10.23): the maidens' vow to the goddess Katyayani, the stealing of the clothes, the praise of Vrindavana's trees, the wives of the brahmanas performing a yajna; cf. Murari 4.07. The stealing of the clothes is a transcendental (aprakrita) lila: Krishna fulfils the maidens' desire to belong to Him (cf. en/48, note 10).
  2. The nauka-lila — Krishna's boat pastime with the gopis on the Manasa-Ganga (cf. Murari 4.08). "Gave themselves as a gift" refers to the gopis' self-surrender; their love is transcendental (cf. en/48, note 10).
  3. The dana-lila: Krishna, like a toll-collector, stops the gopis on their way across Govardhana; the "Dana-ghati" and the "toll platform" are holy places of Govardhana.
  4. The Lord, in Krishna's mood, addresses Radha with the words of the dana-lila.
  5. Tribhanga — Krishna's pose with the flute, bent in three places.
  6. "Radha-kadamba" — so in A and B; apparently a kadamba tree on Govardhana associated with Radha's pastimes (C's note gives the variant "Kanu's kadamba").
  7. Vv. 232–236 follow the Bhagavata (10.24–10.27): Krishna stops the sacrifice to Indra and arranges the worship of Govardhana (Annakuta); Indra sends the deluge; Krishna lifts the hill; the humbled Indra anoints Krishna (Govinda-abhisheka). Hariraya (Hari-deva) and Gopalaraya are Deities on Govardhana; Gopala on Govardhana was revealed by Madhavendra Puri (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 4).
  8. "The stone of anointing" (shila ubatane) — the reading is unclear (B: "to its south"); apparently the stone where, by tradition, Krishna was rubbed with fragrant paste.
  9. Vv. 240–241 follow the Bhagavata (10.28): Varuna's servant carried off Nanda, who had entered the Yamuna before dawn on Dvadashi; Krishna brought him back and then, immersing the cowherds in the Brahma-hrada, showed them His abode.
  10. Krishnadasa recognises Krishna Himself in the Lord: the sannyasi is only His outward guise (cf. en/48, note 13).
  11. Vv. 248–252 follow the Bhagavata (10.29.1–8); cf. Murari 4.09. Lochana Dasa himself calls the gopis' "kama" transcendental (aprakrita). In the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 8; Bhaktisiddhanta), the gopis' "kama" is pure prema, the desire only to please Krishna, without a trace of worldly lust; Madana here is Krishna Himself, Madana-mohana.
  12. Govindaraya — the Deity of Govinda in Vrindavana, revealed by Rupa Gosvami.
  13. The Lord, absorbed in bhava, speaks the words of the participants in the rasa-lila. The 1983 edition reads: "now He says: 'Gopis, stay here!'"
  14. Vv. 263–270 follow the Bhagavata (10.29.18–27): Krishna tests the gopis. Lochana Dasa himself explains that He speaks of duty in order to reveal their hidden devotion and increase their love.
  15. Vv. 276–281 — cf. the gopis' reply in the Bhagavata (10.29.31–41): Krishna is the Atmarama, the Soul of all souls and the true Husband of all, so the gopis' love for Him is no breach of dharma in the worldly sense. Gaudiya Vaishnavas (Bhaktisiddhanta) stress that the parakiya-rasa of Vraja is wholly transcendental and is no model for imitation in the world.
  16. Vv. 285–298 — the rasa-lila (cf. the Bhagavata 10.33; Murari 4.09). Radha is the source from whom all the gopis expand (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4); the 1983 edition reads: "the gopis are portions of Radha, for the sake of rasa." In v. 289 A and C read "as many Radhas, so many Krishnas," B "as many gopis, so many Krishnas." In the 1983 edition vv. 287–295 stand after v. 310.
  17. Radha's anointing as sovereign of Vrindavana (Vrindavaneshvari) is a Vraja tradition, told briefly by Lochana Dasa; it is not in the Bhagavata.
  18. Vv. 299–310 follow the Bhagavata (10.30–10.32): Krishna vanishes from the rasa circle, taking one gopi away; the gopis search for Him, question the trees and enact His lilas; He leaves the chosen gopi too and then appears to all again. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition this chosen gopi is Radha.
  19. Vv. 300+1 — 300+9 are found only in the 1983 edition (not in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition of 1922); the 1903 edition gives only the first of them, in a different wording, in a footnote as the reading of one manuscript. Cf. the Bhagavata 10.30.4–23. Haladhara is Balarama.
